description: Données de réplication pour: "Établissement d'un agrégat de coculture de bactéries du cycle N pour élucider la floculation dans le traitement biologique des eaux usées" is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Leuven. Raw data and metadata related to the recent research on the feasibility to exploit a model (N-cycle) consortium with reduced complexity to fundamentally study bioﬂocculation. The purpose of the dataset is to allow replication of all figures and analyses as described in the corresponding publication and its supplementary information. Coverage: Catholic University of Leuven. The portal shows the English title as "Replication data for: "Establishing a co-culture aggregate of N-cycle bacteria to elucidate flocculation in biological w" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Catholic University of Leuven. Its keywords include FISH, alginate, pure cultures, qPCR, nitriﬁers, bioﬂocculation. The listing shows 2025-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
